reference_strategy: Each archived warm-green screen supplied its layout and content. The Luma home supplied the dark style reference for remaining screens.
color_accuracy: Generated raster concepts approximate the supplied tokens; docs/design/luma.css is the exact normative source.

screens.title: Start with a goal
screens.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer, high-fidelity ui-mockup. Restyle the supplied Autobots desktop UI into the user's shadcn Luma DARK theme. Keep the image straight-on, fully visible, landscape 16:10, no device frame. Preserve the exact layout, sidebar, navigation, headings, content, controls, cards, status labels and proportions. Only change styling to the specified dark theme; no other product changes. All primary action buttons and brand emphasis become BLUE, never green. Neutral near-black page background oklch(0.145 0 0), card/popover/sidebar surfaces oklch(0.205 0 0), main foreground oklch(0.985 0 0), muted/accent surfaces oklch(0.269 0 0), muted foreground oklch(0.708 0 0). Primary button background oklch(0.424 0.199 265.638), near-white button text oklch(0.97 0.014 254.604). Sidebar brand/primary oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815); sidebar selected neutral accent oklch(0.269 0 0), with blue active indicator if needed. Secondary oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033); fine white 10% borders and white 15% input borders, focus rings gray oklch(0.556 0 0), base corner radius 0.625rem (10px). Flat restrained shadcn surfaces, crisp sans-serif typography, clear readable text, no gradients, no glow, no glass, no vignette, no warm off-white surfaces. Green is reserved for semantic success/checks/additions and chart data, using emerald tones; amber only for pending attention; destructive/removals oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216). Keep UI concept · Sample data label. Dark is the default; never show a light canvas.
Input image 1 is the layout/content edit target (Home). Preserve the full goal composer, DeepSeek Flash via OpenRouter selector, all 14 roles link, $1.00 run limit, Start run button, disclosure about sending selected task context to OpenRouter, local files/history status, three expert cards and recent work. Start run must be deep saturated Luma blue. Replace the old green logo with the blue sidebar-primary color. All white cards become dark charcoal. The Home selected sidebar row becomes neutral dark gray, not green. Do not add or remove controls.
